{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS380 |prevtitle=Lucky Lucario II |nextcode=PS382 |nexttitle=Vexing Vespiquen & Unmanageable Mothim II |series=Diamond & Pearl |colorscheme=Sinnoh}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Vexing Vespiquen & Unmanageable Mothim I |subtitle=Speed and Razor Leaf |title_ja=VS ビークインとガーメイルI |title_ro=VS Beequen and Gamale I |image=PS381.png |scheme=Diamond & Pearl |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 381 in [[Pokémon Adventures volume 34|Vol. 34]] |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 44 in [[Pokémon Adventures volume 34|Vol. 5]] |location=[[Iron Island]] }} '''Vexing Vespiquen & Unmanageable Mothim I''' (Japanese: '''VS ビークインと ガーメイルI''' ''VS Vespiquen and Mothim I''), titled '''VS Vespiquen & Mothim I''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 381st chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 44th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Speed and Razor Leaf''' (Japanese: '''すばやさと"はっぱカッター"''' ''Speed and "Leaf Cutter"'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Speed and "Razor Leaf"''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} As he stands by the weakened {{p|Steelix}}, {{adv|Diamond}} spots a moving shadow. [[Riley]] runs to Diamond, pointing out that he is facing the same Steelix that is the leader of the Pokémon who live in the abandoned mine. By reading Steelix's aura, Riley determines that it had lost to a fast-moving foe. Riley decides to delay Diamond's final challenge, instead choosing to investigate the caverns and find out who harmed Steelix. As they enter the lower levels of the cavern, Diamond tells Riley about the shadow he saw. Riley finds this strange, explaining to Diamond that he and {{TP|Riley|Lucario}} should have been able to sense anyone's aura. Suddenly, Riley and Lucario are struck by an unknown attack, knocking them into a pit. Diamond runs down to him and sees that there is [[honey]] spread over his and Lucario's faces. Riley assures Diamond that he is fine and still capable of detecting any potential opponents by sensing their auras. To Riley's surprise, two {{tc|Roughneck}}s announce their presence behind him. They command a {{p|Vespiquen}} to use {{m|Power Gem}}, hitting Riley and Diamond, as well as their Pokémon. The Roughnecks inform them that they knew of Riley's ability to read auras and planned an "aura seal" to render him incapable of fighting back. Diamond demands to know why the men are attacking them, and they reveal that they have already found the [[Pokémon Egg]] from Diamond's challenge. The Roughnecks explain that they are commanding a {{p|Mothim}} to use {{m|Air Slash}} all over the cavern, which is acting as the aura seal that exists to disrupt Riley's senses. They reveal that they used Vespiquen's {{m|Attack Order}} to blind Riley and Lucario with honey, and that the same attack had been used to take out Steelix. Seeing the speed of the Roughnecks' Pokémon, Diamond declares that he will be the one to defeat them, as this will provide a great opportunity for him to prove himself against a fast opponent. Just as Riley worries that Diamond is going to have [[Tru]] use {{m|Razor Leaf}} against such a quick opponent, Diamond calls out that exact move. The attack weakly clashes against Vespiquen's {{m|Defend Order}}, and the Roughnecks laugh at its slow pace. Diamond commands another Razor Leaf attack, and the men laugh once more at its slowness. To their surprise, Diamond compliments Tru, and reveals that he has learned how to control the amount of leaves in each Razor Leaf attack. Riley realizes that by using less leaves, each leaf hits faster. Diamond reveals that when he left the tent the night before, he had been training Tru for this very trick—aiming precisely while using a single leaf. The Roughnecks taunt Diamond, and before he can even finish calling out another Razor Leaf attack, Vespiquen is struck by a single leaf. It causes the Vespiquen to drop the Pokémon Egg into a pile of leaves that Tru had launched from its previous Razor Leaf attacks. One of the Roughnecks commands Vespiquen to use {{m|Heal Order}}, but its drones are too panicked. The drones distract Mothim from disrupting Riley's senses, and he and Lucario are able to unleash a flurry of attacks against the Roughnecks. After tying up their opponents, Riley and Diamond smile at each other as the Egg is safely in their possession. ==Major events== * {{adv|Diamond}} and [[Riley]] investigate who defeated the {{p|Steelix}}. * Diamond battles two {{tc|Roughneck}}s for the [[Pokémon Egg]] that they stole. * Diamond learns to use one leaf from [[Tru]]'s {{m|Razor Leaf}} to pin a Pokémon down. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * [[Riley]] * {{tc|Roughneck}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Torterra}} ([[Tru]]/{{tt|Wig|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Shieldon}} ([[Don]]; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Lucario}} ({{OP|Riley|Lucario}}) * {{p|Vespiquen}} ({{tc|Roughneck}}'s) * {{p|Mothim}} ({{tc|Roughneck}}'s) * {{p|Steelix}} ===Other=== * Vespiquen's Drones (From {{m|Attack Order}}, {{m|Defend Order}} & {{m|Heal Order}}) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 蜂后、紳士蛾I|VS Vespiquen, Mothim I}} (Taiwan)
